facts.fact: nvram_commit_safe returns without flash commit only when nvram_manual==1; otherwise calls nvram_commit and discards its return status.
Native validated Apply calls nvram_set for each changed variable, marks nvram_modified; asus_nvram_commit later calls the native safe commit helper.
Each setter is one SET ioctl with is_temp; no userspace multi-key transaction exposed in this header.
nvram_commit returns COMMIT ioctl status; the ordinary HTTP safe wrapper has no positive save acknowledgment.
SET holds nvram_lock around tuple update/compaction retry; a sequence of setters does not hold one lock across all fields.
COMMIT snapshots non-temp state under nvram_lock, releases it, then acquires nvram_sem for flash comparison/write; do not infer whole Apply+commit atomicity.
User SET length capped at NVRAM_MAX_VALUE_LEN-1; header declares4096.
Stock file_lock uses blocking F_SETLKW; not a ready-made nonblocking PID1 transaction owner.

integration_requirements: Do not add an independent asynchronous flash-commit caller based only on runtime APPLIED
Do not expose direct CGI writes to active profile while it is needed for safe OFF
Keep requested/saved configuration separate from loaded radio identity and observed runtime state
Existing native API has no multi-key all-or-none setter; choose owned recoverable save boundary before enabling Classic Apply
Legacy configured values and factory OFF provisioning require explicit migration/provisioning behavior
Ordinary ON/OFF must remain virtual with no physical radio restart/scan
limits: Source contracts only; no device persistence/power-loss acceptance
Scratch holds pinned source data, not executed vendor binaries
